key_idea: Follow each rope from one end to the other and count it once.
steps: Each rope has its own colour, so you can follow it from end to end.
There is a pink rope, a yellow rope, a blue rope and a green rope.
The yellow rope crosses the others, but it is still just 1 rope.
1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4 ropes. You can also count 8 ends: 8 ends make 4 ropes.

choice_feedback.A: There are more than 2 colours of rope.
choice_feedback.B: Do not forget the yellow rope that crosses the other ropes.
choice_feedback.D: 5 ropes would have 10 ends, but there are only 8 ends.
choice_feedback.E: 6 ropes would have 12 ends, but there are only 8 ends.
